gbm_population_evidence.quote: Participants with histologically confirmed diagnosis of melanoma, glioblastoma/anaplastic astrocytoma, sarcoma or epithelial ovarian cancer/fallopian tube/primary peritoneal cancer
Metastatic Melanoma and Other Solid Tumors

candidate_evidence.quote: In this study researchers want to learn more about a new substance called BAY2666605.
Participants will receive BAY 2666605 at the dose and regimen declared safe in the dose escalation part.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Documented radiological disease progression after treatment with all available standard of care therapies for advanced/metastatic disease and at least one measurable lesion

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Study to Evaluate Safety, Tolerability, Maximum Tolerated or Administered Dose, Pharmacokinetics, Pharmacodynamics and Tumor Response Profile of Schlafen12 Complex Inducer (SLFN12 ci) BAY 2666605

role_evidence.quote: Participants will receive BAY 2666605 at the dose and regimen declared safe in the dose escalation part.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational oral Schlafen12 (SLFN12)-PDE3A complex inducer (velcrin), BAY 2666605
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: BAY2666605 triggers the formation of a complex of two proteins called SLFN12 and PDE3A. This complex drive cancer cells into cell death by a mechanism called apoptosis.

source_quote.quote: Positive SLFN12/PDE3A expression in archival tumour

coder_notes: Solid-tumour basket (melanoma, glioblastoma/anaplastic astrocytoma, sarcoma, ovarian) with glioblastoma named in inclusion. SLFN12/PDE3A co-expression is an entry requirement and is the direct target complex of BAY2666605 per the summary -> candidate-matched. PK outcomes are plasma only. Title lists pharmacodynamics but no PD measurement is specified -> target_engagement_planned unclear. Dose escalation and expansion are sequential parts, no control.
